meta.description: Starting relations between pairs of countries (GDD section 10), -100 hostile to +100 close ally. Pairs not listed start from their alliances, pacts, rivalries and wars (diplomacy-rules.json); these entries replace that value where documented behavior says otherwise. Each entry cites the treaty, agreement or documented event behind it. 'sanctions' lists sanctions in force at the start (who sanctions whom), each with its reason.
meta.source: Treaties and documented diplomatic history known up to mid-2026
